#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
BUNDLE="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Use paths relative to this script so the cron job may run from any directory.
tar -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote and copied $BUNDLE to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
stat -c '%a %n' backup.sh
rm -f "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" /tmp/backup-scp-args
mockbin=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$mockbin/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > /tmp/backup-scp-args
EOF
chmod +x "$mockbin/scp"
(cd /tmp && PATH="$mockbin:$PATH" /work/backup.sh)
test -f "/work/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
printf '%s\n' 'scp arguments:'
cat /tmp/backup-scp-args
tar -tzf "/work/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
rm -rf "$mockbin" /tmp/backup-scp-args "/work/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
